events.title: After Hours @RML: Treasure Scavenger Hunt & Hide N Seek
events.description: Go on a gem scavenger hunt for prizes! Bonus Hide N Seek game. There will be pizza and water ice for dessert. For grades 6-12. Registration required. Note: Please use the front (main) entrance.

events.title: Philadelphia Folk Festival
events.description: The 63rd Philadelphia Folk Festival on the Old Pool Farm, about 45 minutes outside the city. Seven stages of traditional and contemporary folk run all day Saturday, alongside craft vendors, food trucks, educational workshops, camping and hands-on activities for all ages. Presented by the Philadelphia Folksong Society; children under 5 are admitted free…
